description: Route optimization strategies and RGU calculation parameters

petalo.name: Pétalo (Circular Clusters)
petalo.description: Circular sweep by angular sectors from origin. Best for dense urban areas with many stops.

zigzag.name: Zigzag (Linear Sweep)
zigzag.description: Linear sweep along dominant axis with alternating sides. Best for corridor routes.
zigzag.best_for: Stops along a road, highway, or boulevard

nearest.name: Nearest Neighbor
nearest.description: Always visit the closest unvisited stop. Simple and predictable.

farthest_first.name: Farthest-First with Nearest Return
farthest_first.description: Go to farthest stop first, then nearest-neighbor back. Handles outlier stops well.
farthest_first.best_for: One far outlier plus nearby cluster
